meta.name: opportunity-solution-tree
meta.description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree from outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and tests. Use when a stakeholder request needs problem framing before you decide what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将利益相关者请求转化为可验证的解决方案树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在决定构建什么之前先对需求进行问题框架分析
copy.tagline_en: Transform stakeholder requests into a verifiable solution tree
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frame problems before deciding what to build

howto.what: 引导你从利益相关者的需求出发，提取目标成果，生成机会（待解决的问题）、解决方案和实验，并推荐最佳概念验证方案。
howto.when: 当收到一个利益相关者的需求或产品想法，需要在决定构建什么之前进行问题框架分析时触发。

say.text: 销售说我们需要一个移动应用，因为竞争对手有。帮我构建一个机会解决方案树。
say.note: 技能会提取目标成果并生成机会和方案。

say.text: 我们想提高试用转付费率，从15%提升到25%。
say.note: 技能会以此为目标成果，生成相关机会和解决方案。

howto.what_en: Guides you to extract target outcomes from stakeholder requests, generate opportunities (problems to solve), solutions, and experiments, and recommend the best proof-of-concept.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a stakeholder request or product idea needs problem framing before deciding what to build.

say_en.text: Sales says we need a mobile app because competitors have one. Build an OST from this request.
say_en.note: Skill extracts outcome and generates opportunities and solutions.

say_en.text: We want to increase trial-to-paid conversion from 15% to 25%.
say_en.note: Skill uses this as target outcome to generate opportunities and solutions.
